tagline.en: Boston to the Oregon coast, with a hole in the middle
tagline.zh: 自波士顿至俄勒冈海岸，中段有一处缺口

start.en: U.S. 101 in Newport, Oregon, within a mile of the Pacific
start.zh: 俄勒冈州纽波特，距太平洋不足一英里处与 US 101 相接

end.en: Kenmore Square, Boston, Massachusetts, at Massachusetts Route 2
end.zh: 马萨诸塞州波士顿肯莫尔广场，与马萨诸塞 2 号州道相接

en: US 20 is the longest road in the United States and spends most of that length being a local road. It leaves Boston on the Boston Post Road, climbs the Berkshires, and crosses New York on the Cherry Valley Turnpike and the top of the Finger Lakes — a rural line that stays ten or twenty miles south of the Thruway all the way to Buffalo. Through Ohio and Indiana it is the older street parallel to I-90, and in Illinois it threads the industrial south shore of Lake Michigan before turning west for Rockford, Galena and the Mississippi at Dubuque.

West of Sioux City it thins out fast: the Nebraska Sandhills, then Wyoming — Casper, the Wind River Canyon, Cody — and then it stops. Because U.S. Routes are not designated on National Park Service roads, US 20 exists as an East Section ending at Yellowstone's east entrance and a West Section beginning at the west entrance, with unnumbered park roads in between. It resumes across the Snake River plain past Craters of the Moon, crosses Oregon's high desert through Burns and Bend, comes over the Cascades at Santiam Pass, and ends at the Pacific in Newport.
zh: US 20 是全美最长的公路，而其中大部分路程都在充当地方道路。它自波士顿沿波士顿邮政路出城，翻越伯克希尔丘陵，再经樱桃谷收费道与五指湖北缘横穿纽约州——这条乡村线位一路保持在快速干道以南十几二十英里处，直到布法罗。穿过俄亥俄与印第安纳时，它是与 I-90 平行的那条老街；进入伊利诺伊后，它先穿过密歇根湖南岸的工业地带，再折向西去往罗克福德、加莱纳，并在迪比克抵达密西西比河。
苏城以西，路况迅速变得稀疏：先是内布拉斯加沙丘地，然后是怀俄明——卡斯珀、风河峡谷、科迪——接着它就断了。由于美国国道不在国家公园管理局所辖道路上设编号，US 20 分为止于黄石公园东口的「东段」和自西口起算的「西段」，中间以无编号的园区道路相连。它在斯内克河平原重新出现，经过月球陨石坑国家纪念地，横穿俄勒冈高地荒漠的伯恩斯与本德，自圣蒂亚姆山口翻越喀斯喀特山脉，最终在纽波特抵达太平洋。

en: Much of the eastern half is older than the automobile. The Bay Path from Boston inland became the Boston Post Road in the 1700s; in New York, the first Great Western Turnpike reached Cherry Valley in 1799 and the Third Great Western Turnpike — the Cherry Valley Turnpike, and today's US 20 — was chartered in 1803 and finished six years later. West of Illinois the corridor was the Yellowstone Trail, the Plymouth-to-Puget-Sound auto trail of 1912.

The 1925 plan gave US 20 a Pacific terminus at Astoria by way of Yellowstone and Pocatello, and stopped US 30 at Salt Lake City. Oregon, Idaho, Wyoming and Utah objected, met, and agreed that the way through to the Northwest should be southern Wyoming instead. The numbers were swapped: US 30 went on to Oregon, and US 20 was cut off at Yellowstone when the system was approved on 11 November 1926.

Oregon's own highway officials had resisted a westward extension on the grounds that the existing roads were not fit for year-round travel. AASHO finally approved the extension across Idaho and Oregon and on to the coast at Newport on 3 June 1940, making US 20 a 3,277-mile route, second only to US 6. When California's renumbering truncated US 6 in 1964, US 20 inherited the title of longest road in the country and has held it since.
zh: 东半段的很大一部分比汽车还要古老。自波士顿通往内陆的「海湾小径」在 1700 年代成为波士顿邮政路；在纽约州，第一条大西部收费道于 1799 年修抵樱桃谷，而第三条大西部收费道——即樱桃谷收费道，也就是今天的 US 20——于 1803 年获特许，六年后完工。伊利诺伊以西，这条走廊则是黄石小道，即 1912 年组织起来的、自普利茅斯通往普吉特湾的命名汽车道。
1925 年的方案原本让 US 20 经黄石与波卡特洛抵达阿斯托里亚的太平洋端点，而把 US 30 止于盐湖城。俄勒冈、爱达荷、怀俄明与犹他四州提出异议，会商后一致认为通往西北部的通道应改走怀俄明州南部。于是两个编号对调：US 30 继续西行至俄勒冈，而 US 20 在 1926 年 11 月 11 日方案通过时被截止于黄石。
俄勒冈州自己的公路官员也曾反对西延，理由是既有道路不适合全年通行。AASHO 最终于 1940 年 6 月 3 日批准了横穿爱达荷与俄勒冈、直达纽波特海岸的延伸段，使 US 20 成为一条 3,277 英里的路线，长度仅次于 US 6。1964 年加州重新编号截短 US 6 后，US 20 继承了「全美最长公路」之名，并保持至今。

en: Two pieces of US 20 have documented price tags, and both predate the federal-aid era as we know it. The Third Great Western Turnpike, chartered in 1803, cost $105,000 to build from Cherry Valley through Cazenovia to the Seneca Turnpike near Syracuse — money raised by a private stock company under New York's Turnpike Law of 1797, and recovered at tollgates until the last toll was collected in 1857.

The other is a mile and a half in Sudbury, Massachusetts. Henry Ford, who then owned the Wayside Inn, was told in 1926 that truck traffic on the Boston Post Road was damaging the building's foundations. He paid to build a bypass around it, finished it on 11 December 1928, and sold it to the Commonwealth for one dollar — a cheque, the story goes, that he never cashed. The road he gave away is the US 20 that traffic uses today; the old alignment past the inn is now Wayside Inn Road.
zh: US 20 上有两段留有明确的造价记录，且都早于我们今天所理解的联邦补助时代。1803 年获特许的第三条大西部收费道，自樱桃谷经卡泽诺维亚修至锡拉丘兹附近的塞内卡收费道，造价 10.5 万美元——资金由一家私人股份公司依纽约州 1797 年《收费道路法》募集，靠收费站回收，最后一笔通行费收于 1857 年。
另一段在马萨诸塞州萨德伯里，长一英里半。1926 年，时为路边客栈（Wayside Inn）业主的亨利·福特被告知，波士顿邮政路上的货车交通正在损坏该建筑的地基。他自费修建了一条绕行线，于 1928 年 12 月 11 日完工，并以一美元的价格卖给马萨诸塞州——据说那张支票他从未兑现。他送出去的这段路，就是今天车流所走的 US 20；经过客栈门前的旧线位如今名为「路边客栈路」。

value.en: $105,000, chartered 1803 and completed six years later from Cherry Valley to the Seneca Turnpike — the section of today's US 20 still called the Cherry Valley Turnpike
value.zh: 10.5 万美元；1803 年获特许，六年后建成，自樱桃谷至塞内卡收费道，即今日 US 20 上仍被称作「樱桃谷收费道」的路段

figures.source: New York State Department of Transportation, Route 20 Scenic Byway corridor management plan, 2016

label.zh: 亨利·福特出资的路边客栈绕行线

value.en: $288,000 for a mile and a half, completed 11 December 1928 and sold to the Commonwealth of Massachusetts for $1
value.zh: 一英里半造价 28.8 万美元，1928 年 12 月 11 日完工，以 1 美元售予马萨诸塞州

figures.source: Town of Sudbury, "Sudbury, 1890–1989: 100 Years in the Life of a Town," citing the Boston Herald

why.en: No figure exists. US 20 was numbered in 1926 over turnpikes, post roads and auto trails already in use, and has been rebuilt by twelve states over a century.
why.zh: 没有这样的数据。US 20 于 1926 年沿早已通行的收费道、邮政路与命名汽车道编号，此后由 12 个州历经一个世纪陆续改建。

label.en: Length in the official route logs

value.en: 3,277 miles after the 1940 extension to Newport; 3,365 miles in the 1989 AASHTO log, the most recent published, making it the longest road in the country
value.zh: 1940 年延伸至纽波特后为 3,277 英里；1989 年 AASHTO 里程表（迄今最新一份）列为 3,365 英里，为全美最长的公路

figures.source: Federal Highway Administration, "Ask the Rambler: What Is The Longest Road in the United States?"

why.en: Twelve state agencies count US 20 separately. The route is a city street in Boston, Cleveland and Gary and an empty two-lane road across the Nebraska Sandhills and the Oregon high desert; there is no meaningful route-wide number and none is published.
why.zh: 12 个州的机构各自统计 US 20。这条路在波士顿、克利夫兰与加里是城市街道，在内布拉斯加沙丘地与俄勒冈高地荒漠则是空旷的双车道公路；全线数字既无实质意义，也无人发布。

value.en: US 20 is officially divided into an East Section ending at Yellowstone's east entrance and a West Section beginning at the west entrance, because U.S. numbered highways are not designated on National Park roads
value.zh: US 20 在官方上分为止于黄石公园东口的东段与自西口起算的西段，因为美国国道不在国家公园道路上设编号

conditionFigures.source: Federal Highway Administration, "Ask the Rambler: What Is The Longest Road in the United States?"

timeline.en: The Third Great Western Turnpike — the Cherry Valley Turnpike — is chartered in New York.
timeline.zh: 纽约州特许设立第三条大西部收费道，即樱桃谷收费道。

timeline.en: US 20 is approved on 11 November, from Boston to the east entrance of Yellowstone National Park.
timeline.zh: 11 月 11 日 US 20 获批，自波士顿至黄石国家公园东口。

timeline.en: Henry Ford's bypass around the Wayside Inn at Sudbury opens on 11 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 11 日，亨利·福特出资修建的萨德伯里路边客栈绕行线通车。

timeline.en: AASHO approves the extension across Idaho and Oregon to Newport on 3 June, giving US 20 a Pacific terminus.
timeline.zh: 6 月 3 日 AASHO 批准横穿爱达荷与俄勒冈、直达纽波特的延伸段，US 20 由此获得太平洋端点。

timeline.en: With US 6 truncated in California, US 20 becomes the longest road in the United States.
timeline.zh: US 6 在加州被截短后，US 20 成为全美最长的公路。
